scope: Consume external entry/exit signals and execution outcomes; never generate strategy signals

entry_outcomes.EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED: ENTRY_FAILED with no position and structured issue

baseline_position_rule: One open position per security; a new entry while the economic position exists is IGNORED_WHILE_POSITION_OPEN

exit_outcomes.NO_FILL: OPEN, retain position, clear pending exit, and retain incremented exit_attempt_count
exit_outcomes.EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED: EXIT_UNRESOLVED with the position and structured reason retained

corporate_action_handling: SPLIT, DIVIDEND, RIGHTS and SECURITY_CODE_CHANGE produce POSITION_CORPORATE_ACTION_UNRESOLVED; raw entry price, indicator basis and quantity semantics remain recorded
trading_lifecycle_handling: DELISTING, RELISTING, LONG_SUSPENSION and TRADING_LIFECYCLE_TERMINATION produce POSITION_TRADING_LIFECYCLE_UNRESOLVED; no forced price is fabricated
